promptText:

- [EXACT TEACHER-PASTED QUESTION OR SET]
- [TEACHER-SUPPLIED EXAM AND YEAR LABEL]
- [TEACHER-SUPPLIED ANSWER OR MARKING SCHEME]
- [CLASSROOM GOAL]
- [VIVA LENGTH AND RESPONSE MODE]
